Potential risks: No dedicated staff to develop and monitor performance indicators
Mitigation strategies: » Use existing operational staff to define indicators using existing resources such as the NSCA key performance indicators (KPIs) (22). » Incorporate the identified KPIs into ongoing operational processes and workflows (where feasible) to minimize manual data collection and analysis.

Potential risks: Funding gaps to advance strategic goals
Mitigation strategies: » Adopt a phased approach to achieving the goals. Define phases that are manageable from a funding and capacity perspective. » Engage and collaborate with partners and donors to identify funding opportunities. » Temporarily reduce the scope of specific lower-priority initiatives until additional funds are available.

Potential risks: Available funding does not align with the established timeline
Mitigation strategies: » Develop the roadmap iteratively in close collaboration with funding partners to incorporate their feedback and ensure alignment.
